comparison.objective: Buck a log at a mark using a two-person crosscut saw; candidate commissions a compact shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Alternating pull-only sawing with two handles differs from precision key insertion, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, and locking torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Saw must sever the log without pushing and kinking the blade, then be released; candidate requires two quantified safe carriage stops. Cut accuracy and kink thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Saw coordination tests a different physical capability.
